summary: Spot-locator SOS activation near Maroon Pass activated Crested Butte Search and Rescue; a St. Mary's helicopter located the party and flew one individual to an Aspen-area hospital for unknown injuries.
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Mt. Crested Butte Police Department; St. Mary's helicopter
notes: CBSAR stood down after helicopter extraction; injuries and circumstances unknown (only communication was the spot-locator emergency notification). Date stated in-story as Saturday, August 29 (2015-08-29 = Saturday, verified).
